title: Signal Component Schema
description: Single source of truth for the component-tree contract shared between bff/ and mobile/. Both sides must stay in sync with this file: bff/ renders responses that validate against it, mobile/ renders any component whose 'type' appears in componentTypes without knowing what the type means.

component.description: A generic node in a component tree. type selects the definition below that data must satisfy.

action_button.description: A button that, when tapped, triggers a named backend action (POST /action/{action}) with the given params.

action.description: Action name, e.g. 'explain'. Client posts to /action/{action}.

params.description: Optional extra params merged into the action request body.

token_card.description: Displays a single token's price and an AI-generated insight, with a button to request more explanation.

insight.description: Short AI-generated or static insight line.

icon_url.description: Hosted logo URL; null falls back to a monogram avatar.

rank.description: Market cap rank (1 = largest), null when unavailable.

bottom_sheet.description: A modal sheet shown in response to an action, e.g. an AI explanation.

body.description: Main sheet content. May be multi-paragraph plain text.

close_label.description: Label for the dismiss button, e.g. 'Close' or 'Got it'.

token.description: Raw token name the sheet is about, e.g. 'Bitcoin' — distinct from the composed title.

icon_url.description: Echoed from the triggering token_card; null falls back to a monogram.

ai_generated.description: True when body came from the LLM (explain); false for fixed-copy actions (compare).
